registered_tldr: TLDR: Can evidence-backed dissent earn a bounded independent check, withdraw when wrong, and reopen on new evidence? Three synthetic scenarios compare Jev admission with majority, veto, always-check, fixed random checking, pooled evidence and an exact rule. Measure correct on-time decisions, harmful reversals, checking cost and recovery. Scripted votes and fixed grammar limit generalization; exploratory study, independent review pending.
run_tldr: TLDR: Q1-A1 pairs generic and explicit single-criterion instructions on 18 fresh clean Jev packets plus six absent/conflicting-evidence controls. Compare accuracy by scenario and paired changes; qualify only clarified 16/18 correct, 17/18 valid, 5/6 per domain and all six valid DEFER controls. Repeated synthetic grammar limits generalization.
